Hellfire is a channeled PBAoE Demonology warlock spell, which ignites the surrounding area, dealing an equal amount of Fire damage to the Warlock and to all nearby enemies.

Hellfire Citadel is the headquarters of the fel orcs of Outland, a nearly impenetrable bastion that once served as the base of operations for the orcs throughout the First and Second Wars. Kargath Bladefist and his fel orcs now make their home in the citadel.

Helm's Bed Lake is a smallish lake in southeastern Dun Morogh. Although the lake has mostly frozen over, a hole in the ice is maintained at all times in order to provide access to fresh water. While travel across the lake itself is quite safe, the surrounding area is crawling with dangerous wildlife and stray troggs. As if that was not enough, Dark Iron dwarves have also taken control of an abandoned building south of the lake, and will attack anyone who wanders too close. The body of Narm Faulk is situated here. During the Legion Invasions, the western coast of the lake was invaded by the demons.

.]] Helhounds are gigantic, three-headed hounds found in the Shadowlands realms of Maldraxxus and Revendreth, as well as Helya's domain of Helheim. Maldraxxus' House of the Chosen use helhounds as war companions.

.]] Helboars, also known as felboars and demonic boars, are spiny, mottled boars that burn with different colored flames. It comes in a variety of looks, possibly related to the amount of exposure it has had to the demonic energies of the Twisting Nether. Helboar were once ordinary boars, now mutated by demonic influence. In Azeroth, the helboar is native only to the Blasted Lands. The Outland variety found on Hellfire Peninsula shows far larger signs of demonic blood. Their hides are brightly colored and twisted into a vile parody of a boar. Helboars also started appearing on after the corruption of Tanaan Jungle.
__NOTOC__ Hegnar Swiftaxe is a dwarf axe vendor located at Timberline Arms in the Military Ward in Ironforge.

Heigan the Unclean is the second boss of the Plague Quarter in Naxxramas. He is the famous "dance boss". If you master the dance, then you master the fight. Some may view this as an easy feat, while many players struggle to master the concept.
The Helm of Heroism is a quest reward from Saving the Best for Last.
The Helm of Exile is a quest reward from Jammal'an the Prophet (Classic).
The Helm of Fire is a crafted leather helmet often sought by Rogues and feral Druids.

__NOTOC__ Helene Peltskinner is a human skinning trainer located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. More specifically, she is in the home of Adele Fielder on the outskirts north-east of Goldshire. She has been of great assistance to Adele Fielder, her friend, since Adele's husband, who is in the army, "left for the front".
Heightened Senses is a tier 5 talent in the Subtlety rogue tree. Maxing it requires a total of 22 points in Subtlety.

Hellfire Ramparts (often known as just "Ramps" or "The Ramparts") make up the first wing of the Hellfire Citadel instance in Hellfire Peninsula, Outland. The citadel itself sits in the center of the zone, in the middle of a broken-up wall that divided the zone before the conflict began. The Ramparts takes place atop this wall along the sides of the citadel. This is the first instance available to players of the Burning Crusade, and can be completed wearing dungeon set items. It gives rewards that are on par with Molten Core gear (or even slightly better).
.]] Hellreaver is a polearm that drops from Vazruden in the Hellfire Ramparts wing of Hellfire Citadel on normal difficulty. He used the weapon itself during the fight.
The Hellslayer Battle Axe, also known as hellslayer waraxe, is a two-handed axe designed for holy warriors.

__NOTOC__ Helgrum the Swift was once an orc quest giver located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows. With the coming of the Cataclysm, he now lays dying in the tower a Splinterspear Junction -- a victim of the renewed Alliance assault on the territory. His companion, Neeka Bloodscar, watches over him. Neeka now seeks to save her protege, or at least ease his suffering. He ultimately dies to his wounds.
Helendis Riverhorn is a night elf quest giver located at Morgan's Vigil in the Burning Steppes.

Helcular's Revenge is a Horde quest in which players must find the rod of Helcular so that his apprentice may have his revenge on the citizens of Southshore. Yeti occupy Helcular's former hideout, so any yeti may have it.

Hellfire Fortifications is the Horde quest related to the world PvP objective of Hellfire Peninsula. It involves capturing three strategic locations surrounding Hellfire Citadel. It can only be completed once every 24 hours.

Hellfire Basin is located on the backside of Hellfire Citadel on Hellfire Peninsula. It is a wide, sloping area that descends from the three PvP-objective buildings at the top towards the citadel, where it swings around to the south. There can be found the ominous entrance to Magtheridon's Lair. The Demoniac Scryer needs to be placed here for The Demoniac Scryer.

Hellfire Peninsula is a level 58-60 zone in Outland and the first zone of World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade. The progress for the storyline of this zone is tracked by achievement To Hellfire and Back. Breadcrumbs which lead players into Hellfire Peninsula come from the Blasted Lands or the notice boards in capital cities. Optional breadcrumbs: * Hero's Call: Outland! * Warchief's Command: Outland! * (From the Blasted Lands: Through the Dark Portal (quest))
Hellfire Wardling are fel imps that spawn during the quest The Demoniac Scryer in Hellfire Basin in the Hellfire Peninsula.

Helcular's Remains is an elite undead that spawns at the Southshore graveyard in Hillsbrad Foothills after a Horde player completes the Helcular's Revenge quest. He seeks revenge from the people of Southshore. This is the undead form of the human mage Helcular. When in combat, he occasionally summons level 42 (non-elite) skeletons, which then despawn about a minute after combat.

Hellfire Spineleaves can be found in south-eastern Hellfire Peninsula.

__NOTOC__ Hellfire Superiority is a zone-wide buff in Hellfire Peninsula for the faction that control all three PvP locations: the Stadium, Broken Hill, and the Overlook.

Helka Grimtotem is the niece of Magatha Grimtotem. She is a gladiator mistress and bought Valeera Sanguinar from Rehgar Earthfury for 2000 gold after his team won at the Dire Maul tournament. Helka wanted Valeera to lead an all-female gladiator team consisting of an orc and a troll. However soon after they set out for an exhibition game on the Merchant Coast, Valeera escaped with the wyvern Bristlefur.

Heirlooms (also referred to as just looms) are an item type that was introduced with Wrath of the Lich King. The items have a light blue hue in their text color (golden before patch 7.0.3), and their attributes scale with the character's level, with upgrades to increase the max level it can scale to. Nearly all heirloom items are named after popular items from the early days of classic WoW and share the look of these items. Once purchased, heirlooms are learned like mounts, pets, and toys, and show up in the Heirlooms tab. From there, players can upgrade their heirlooms to be effective for more levels, and to make copies of the heirlooms to use on a character. Heirlooms can be mailed to any

Hellscream's Warsong is an area buff granted to all Horde players in Nagrand after completing the long Mag'har quest chain that ends with Hero of the Mag'har. It boosts hitpoints by 300, grants 15% haste to melee, and allows 10 mana regen every 5 seconds. During the event in which Thrall visits Garadar, after speaking with Greatmother Geyah, he shows Garrosh the truth about his father, Grom Hellscream. After seeing the image (a spiritual re-enactment of the battle with Mannoroth in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos), Garrosh gives this buff. This buff cannot be given if Thrall is already there when Hero of the Mag'har is turned in.

Hellscream's Grasp is a small Horde camp located in Tol Barad Peninsula. It is most likely named after the new Horde's Warchief Garrosh Hellscream, who also commanded the creation of Hellscream's Reach, Tol Barad's Horde faction, or possibly as a tribute to the great orcish hero Grom Hellscream leader of the Warsong clan, and Garrosh's father.

Hellscream's Elite are the forces who arrive at Forsaken High Command in Silverpine Forest with Garrosh Hellscream in the quest The Warchief Cometh. Despite their name, they are not elite mobs, though they are fairly numerous and intimidating. They spawn around and stand in front of a special-purpose portal to Orgrimmar during the quest, and leave with Garrosh once the scripted event between him and Sylvanas Windrunner has run its course.

Hellscream's Vanguard (or simply the Vanguard) were a force of orcs led by Legionnaire Nazgrim, commanded to conquer the land recently raised in the area of Vashj'ir, in an effort to invade Stormwind.
Hellscream Grunts are orc guards found at Zoram'gar Outpost and Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale.

Hell-Hoot is an owl in northern Winterspring. assumes she would taste good and wants her killed. Locals originally named her "Deathwing" but changed it to "Hell-Hoot" when they realized it was already taken.

Hell hounds (also called flame hounds or charhounds) are fiery beasts from the Firelands. Shannox serves as the kennel master to these creatures. These dogs fear nothing and will not stop until their lust for blood is satisfied.

Hellfire Channelers are orcs keeping Magtheridon bound in Magtheridon's Lair. Once one is engaged, the rest will aggro and begin the fight. When all the channelers die, Magtheridon will break free and enter combat.

Some members of the crew (between them the player, Nazgrim and Dubs) left the airship to attack directly the stronghold but, after being confronted by them, Captain Doren of the Alliance forces escapes with a gyrocopter, managing to deal a fatal blow to the gunship in the meantime. At an unknown point in time, he and Rokhan were part of a Horde scouting mission at Blackfathom Deeps. The mission went bad with only the two Darkspear trolls surviving. The wounded Hekazi was saved by Rexxar, who happened to be nearby, with Misha carrying him on her back. Hekazi became known as a hero, with Rokhan remembering him as one of his bravest hunters. Helgarde Keep is a citadel within Desmotaeron that was inaccessible prior to patch 9.1.0. The helhound Ylva, Guarm's mate, and their children Vargir, Girs, Frekki, Hrodvetni, and Vanargun all reside here. Every level of Helgarde Keep has prison cells along its inner walls with various prisoners, including Benedictus Voss. The instance portal to Sanctum of Domination can be found at in the northern extent of the keep.

Herbalism is a gathering profession that allows players to find and harvest herbs from plant resource nodes scattered around the world. While some herbs can be used in other trade skills, the vast majority are used for Alchemy and Inscription. Herbalism also called botanical medicine or phytomedicine, refers to using a plant's seeds, berries, roots, leaves, bark, or flowers for medicinal purposes, but the game does not stricly adhere to that definition. As with most types of gathering, interacting with an herb will dismount the herbalist. In World of Warcraft, herb can mean one of three things: # A plant or part of a plant that usually serves as an ingredient in some profession (usually Alchemy) but sometimes has some other use, as with certain quest items and the reagents for a druid's rebirth spell. # A plant resource node which can be harvested by those with the Herbalism profession to gain the above item or items. # The act of harvesting such a resource with Herbalism. This is used primarily in reference to "herb skinning": the harvesting of herbs from the corpses of plant monsters. The Helm of the Anvilmars, also known as the Crown of the Anvilmars, is worn by the patriarch of the dwarven Anvilmar family. Recently this was Hjalmar Anvilmar, until he was captured by the Dark Irons at Thandol Span. Balgaras the Foul planned to kill Hjalmar by fusing his helm to his face with a fire spell, but was interrupted when Hjalmar's brother Thargas arrived, cut off Balgaras' hand, and freed Hjalmar. Before dying, the wounded Balgaras managed to set off an explosion, but Hjalmar jumped in front of the blast to absorb it with his body, mortally injuring him in the process. This item Helm of the Unsubmissive from Sapphiron in the 10-man version of Naxxramas. The archlich Kel'Thuzad had a great, skeletal frost wyrm named Sapphiron as the guard dog to his sanctum. The armor that came from the monster's lair is of a great variety; the Helm of the Unsubmissive is a suitably intimidating plate helmet for fierce warriors.
